notes_general: Materials catalog for Slackline.Ova gear autocomplete. MBS = Minimum Breaking Strength (kN). WLL = Working Load Limit (kN). ISA certification per Slacktivity/Balance Community/ISA gear DB (2026 stav). Kde chybí publikovana data uvedeno null a 'MBS unpublished, verify with vendor' v notes. Sewn loop pravidlo (ISA:21 App6, 80% rule) — MBS uvedena pro webbing samotny, sewn loop je typicky ~80% te hodnoty.

webbing.notes: Hybrid UHMWPE/PES, ISA cert, univerzalni HL 40-200 m. RLT: ISA neuvadi (UHMWPE hybrid), vyrobce/optical inspection.
29 g/m ultralight. NENI ISA-cert na HL (jen plna Y2K 25mm je Type A). Longline/park OK. Se seaHorse 20/25mm nutny 3D spacer (PETG/nylon).
61.5 g/m, 4% stretch @10kN. Klasika longline, blize rodeo feelingu. PES A/A+ = optical/haptical inspection (bez fixniho RLT limitu).
Prvni oficialni highline webbing na trhu. Tubular. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor (Type A = 30+ kN).
ISA:41 Type A. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor (Type A = 30+ kN).
Tubular ISA:41 Type A. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Nylon tubular ISA:41 Type A, dynamicky. RLT 720 dnu (PA Type A). MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Dynamicky nylon, rodeo/park. Type B/C dle MBS (unpublished, verify with vendor). RLT 180-360 dnu.
Longline (80m). MBS + material family unpublished, verify with vendor.
53 g/m, ~12% stretch @10kN. Mainline HL 50m (nylon = mekky raz, nizsi peak force). Type B PA (26+ kN). RLT 360 dnu.
62 g/m, 4% @10kN. Longline (30m). PES Type A = optical/haptical inspection.
59 g/m, 4% @10kN. HL backup (50m HL). PES Type A = optical/haptical inspection.
PES longline. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
33 g/m, <3% @10kN. Ultra-light HL 50-200 m. ISA cert nejisty (hybrid), overit u vyrobce.
44 g/m, vysoky stretch (dynamicky). Rodeo/dynamicky. Nejvyssi stretch z hightech popruhu.
PES highline ISA:41 Type A. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor (Type A = 30+ kN).
PES highline ISA:41 Type A. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
PES longline ISA:41 Type A. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Popularni HL webbing (USA). MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Popularni longline (USA). MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
PES highline (DE). MBS + typ unpublished, verify with vendor.

weblock.notes: Prvni ISA:51 cert HighTech HL weblock. Sloty 2 (uzky+siroky) pro 19-20 + 25-27 mm. Y2K Light (18mm) potrebuje 3D spacer PETG/nylon. MBS ≥ 48 kN garantovano standardem ISA:21.
200 g, 17-26 mm se spacery (removable, allen klic ~5 min). Soft release 13 m. 3sigma MBS 63 kN. Pro uzke popruhy (17-20 mm) primarni volba, native spacers.
Ultralight, necertifikovany. Jen kratke lajny <30 m, ne HL pod ISA deklaraci. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Necertifikovany. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Slacktivity weblock. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Tensioning system Thomase Buckinghama (ISA president). Simple 3:1 max 2 kN, Compound 5:1 max 4 kN, 9:1 max 5 kN (per 1 osoba). Sweet spot 5:1 pro solo.

shackle.notes: WLL 3250 kg, MBS 6:1 = 130 kN. Screw pin. Prumyslovy standard, kompatibilni s shackle-based riggingem.
WLL 4000 kg, MBS 6:1 = 160 kN. Robustnejsi variant pro festival rigging.
WLL 6500 kg. Overkill pro slackline, ale komun ve fest rigging.
Lehky soft shackle pro anchor buildy. Roberto (Rodeo Rigs 20.8.2026): NIKDY single soft shackle mezi BFK a rigging plate (mistake).
Vetsi soft shackle. Verify MBS with vendor.
Aluminum shackle, climbing norma EN 362 (ne ISA). MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Ocelovy triangle quick link. MBS 50 kN major axis, 25 kN minor. Weight ~148 g.
Semi-circular karabina pro harness belay loop. Multi-directional (major=15 kN). Ne pro main anchor.

carabiner.notes: HMS pear-shape. 27/7/8 kN (major/minor/open). Gate opening 25 mm, ~84 g. Univerzalni pro belay / HL master connector.
HMS s automatickym ball-lock. 27/7/8 kN. ~86 g. Auto-lock = doporuceno pro HL leash/master.
Asymetrick D. 27/8/10 kN (major/minor/open). Gate 21 mm, ~85 g. HL leash connector, belay.
27/8/10 kN. Gate 21 mm, ~82 g. Screwgate variant.
Oval symetric. 24/8/8 kN. Gate 17 mm, ~82 g. Pro rigging (pulleys) - oval udrzi zatez centralne.
24/8/8 kN. Gate 17 mm, ~76 g. Screwgate variant.
Lehky HMS pro belay. 22/7/6 kN. Gate 21 mm, ~56 g. Ne pro main anchor (nizsi MBS).
Auto-lock wire gate, snadny na jedno rukou. 25/8/8 kN. Gate 21 mm, ~72 g. Popularni pro via ferrata a HL leash.
HMS s dodatecnym friction spur (anti-cross-loading, brake for descender). 25/9/8 kN. ~90 g.
Small D. 23/8/9 kN. Gate 15 mm, ~64 g. Kompaktni.
Cesky HMS, ~80 g. 25/8/9 kN. Verify MBS with vendor (Rock Empire datasheet).
Ocelovy oval, auto-twist lock. 30/15/15 kN. ~200 g. Pro industrial rigging / kotvitka.
HMS auto-lock, gate ~24 mm. 25/8/9 kN, ~92 g.
Ultralight ~28 g. 22/8/8 kN. Pro rack / quickdraws, ne main anchor.
HMS screwgate, ~78 g, gate 24 mm. 25/8/8 kN.

sling.notes: WLL 1000 kg (10 kN working), MBS 7:1 = 70 kN. Fialovy = 1T standard barevny kod EN. Basket hitch +100%, larks foot -50%. Delky 0.5-6 m.
WLL 2000 kg, MBS 140 kN. Zeleny = 2T EN. Primary anchor sling pro velke stromy / boulders.
WLL 3000 kg, MBS 210 kN. Zluty = 3T EN. Fest rigging / velke boulder anchors.
Sewn sling 22 kN. ~26 g. Climbing quality. Nesnasi vysoke teploty (140 st C), pozor na tie-off + electrostatic.
Sewn sling 22 kN, ~52 g. Basket hitch = 44 kN, larks foot ~11 kN.
Slacktivity anchor sling. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.
Balance Community anchor sling. MBS ~27 kN typicky. Verify with vendor.

leash.notes: Prvni ISA:37 cert leash. Sewn termination na obou koncich s thimble/ring. ~1.2 m standard. Verify exact MBS with vendor.
BC leash. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor. Standard ~1.2-1.5 m.
Prusik/backup rope. NE jako leash line (nizka MBS). Pro rescue prusiky.
Alternativa k rope leash. NE-dynamic material, tvrdsi raz. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.

ring.notes: ISA:37 cert leash ring, ~30 EUR. Prvni ISA:37 cert ring. Doporucuje se par pro redundanci.
Vortex kruh, MBS 39 kN. NENI explicit ISA:37 cert (ale MBS OK). Sascha Grill (Rodeo Rigs): tape gate shut vzdy (tape gate).
BC leash ring. MBS unpublished, verify with vendor.

harness.notes: Ultralight HL harness, ~240 g. Belay loop 15 kN. Popularni pro long HL sessions (mala vaha, dobra rozlozeni tlaku).
Comfort harness pro rigging (~490 g). Adjustable leg loops. Sirokovy pas pro dlouho na anchor.
Via ferrata / rigging harness s adjustable leg loops (~455 g).
Univerzalni climbing harness, ~490 g. Dostupny cenove, robusni.
Rescue harness s dorsalnimi attachment points. Pro rescue rigger / hauling operations.
Ultralight harness, ~185 g. HL alternativa k Sitta.

pas.notes: Adjustable dynamic PAS, ~113 g. Delka 15-95 cm. Absorbuje energii pri padu (dynamic rope).
Double leg PAS, redundantni. Kratsi rameno fixed, delsi adjustable.
5-loop static PAS, 22 kN. NE-dynamic - tvrdsi raz, pozor na fall factor.
Chain of sewn loops, 22 kN. Alternativa k PAS 22.
Double dynamic PAS s karabinami. Redundantni pro anchor transitions.

rescue.notes: Progress capture pulley, rope 8-13 mm. MBS 15 kN, WLL 4 kN. ~85 g. TZ pouziva na PAS jako self-tending pri Texas ascent. Efficiency ~91%.
Bigger progress capture pulley, rope 8-13 mm. ~200 g. MBS 23 kN. Efficiency ~91%.
Single pulley, ~26 g. Rope max 11 mm. Efficiency ~71%. Pro racks / ultralight setup.
Large swivel rescue pulley, rope max 13 mm. ~360 g. MBS 36 kN.
Handled ascender, rope 8-13 mm. Slippage limit ~4 kN. ~165 g. Prava ruka. TZ Texas system: 2x Ascension + Micro Traxion.
Handled ascender, leva ruka. Ostatni jako Ascension R.
Chest ascender (bez handle), rope 8-13 mm. ~300 g. Pro chest attachment v Frog/Texas system.
Self-braking descender, rope 10-11.5 mm. WLL 150 kg. ~530 g. Anti-panic. Doporuceno pro HL rescue descent.
Larger self-braking descender, rope 11.5-13 mm. WLL 150 kg. Pro heavier loads / tandem rescue.
Industrial descender, rope 10-11.5 mm. Anti-panic. Bez pripojene karabiny na load side. ~380 g. Popularni pro HL rescue.
Assisted braking belay device, rope 8.5-11 mm. ~200 g. Pozor: NE anti-panic (na rozdil od Rig/I'D). Roberto: pro descent NE-GriGri, pouzij Rig/I'D/Pinch.
Starsi self-braking descender, rope 10-11.5 mm. Bez anti-panic. Nahrazovan Rig/I'D.
Nasslap (foot loop) pro ascending. Rychlouprinovaci prasknuti. TZ Texas system: pripevneno na jumary.
Adjustable foot loop. Pro solo ascending Basic/Ascension.
Load cell tension monitor s Bluetooth (iOS only, mensi accuracy ±2%). WLL 8 kN, MBS 25 kN. Vhodne pro HL research, drazsi nez LineGrip.
Load cell 30 kN WLL / 90 kN MBS (test 145 kN). Accuracy ±0.5%, 1280 Hz sampling, on-board 50h logging, BLE 5.0 iOS+Android. IP68. ~25 000 Kc (Slacktivity).
4:1 pre-rigged haul kit s pulleys + rope grab. ~485 g. Rychla mechanical advantage pro rescue.
